novel.title: Novel
sample: Rowan knelt beside the harbor stones as the guild wardens dragged his father onto the pier.
In the first timeline he had begged for mercy, and by autumn their house was ash.
Tonight the seal had not yet broken.
He stared at the cipher tucked inside the magistrate’s sleeve and stood. “Hold the warrant. My father never stole that ledger.”
“I know where it is. Locked in your own vault, my lord.”

short.title: Short story
short.promise: Write up to the first twist
sample: The night before our wedding, my fiancé gave the dress I’d sewn for three years to his first love.
“She has terminal stomach cancer. Be reasonable.”
I stared at the diagnosis and said nothing.
The doctor who signed it was me. I never wrote that report.
Three days ago I examined her myself: gastritis.
So I swapped tomorrow’s wedding slideshow for her clinic footage.

screenplay.title: Short drama script
sample: In front of every guest, Evelyn Vance splashes a glass of red wine across Claire’s dress.
EVELYN: A nobody marrying into the Vance family? The new majority owner arrives tonight. Get out.
CLAIRE: (wiping her cheek) No need to wait. The owner is already here.
A corporate attorney walks past Evelyn and bows to Claire, holding out a leather folder.
ATTORNEY: Chairwoman Claire, the Vance Group buyout agreement. Ready to sign?
